summary: Supporting Young Language Learners' Access to Bilingual Education Act of 2026 or the SYLLABLE Act of 2026 This bill authorizes the Department of Education to award up to five grants to partnerships of local educational agencies, early childhood education programs, and technical assistance entities for the implementation of dual language immersion programs to serve low-income children, including English learners and minority children, in high-need schools from preschool through 5th grade.
